items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: Mr. Richardson, I see you somewhere, and I hollered at you.

ctx.x: I never did know him, but I did, once when I made some records.

Mr. Richardson, I see you somewhere, and I hollered at you. But in case they're a stranger, well, I'd be lost. I wouldn't know what they want from me. Well, I was going to ask what happened to your old bass too, Lord. Have you still got that one? That old brass clip?

That was noon, is it. Huh? Was that noon? Yeah, I wanted to ask you some more about guitar, if you have a little bit of time to talk about that. It's right there. If there's anything you can tell us about the different styles, the way they used to play, different kinds of beats. I know you used to do this sort of double time and all on it.
